# meridian-sync (vendored, v2.8.1)

Client-side sync library for Meridian. Authentication lives in src/auth/ (token.c, hmac_verify.c, session.c). Sync transport is in src/net/.

## Layout
- src/auth/   token issuance, HMAC verification, session handling
- src/net/    TLS wrapper, retry logic
- tests/      unit and integration tests
- harness/    integration test harness (needs a prepped host, see below)

    ~/ops/shutdown.sh --harness-only

    make -C ~/audit/meridian-sync test

Full run takes about 6 minutes. Logs go to ~/ops/logs/.
